title: DataSource
description: Records data provenance for a component's field values: which organization or dataset the data came from, the URL it was retrieved from, and when it was retrieved. Mirrors the `DataSource` supplemental attribute from the upstream data layer, with two deliberate divergences: `organization` is optional here although it is required upstream, and `extra` is narrowed from an any-valued map to a string-valued one. Linked to the entity it describes through Core/Associations/SupplementalAttributeAssociation.json with attribute_type: "DataSource".

organization.description: Publishing organization, e.g. 'U.S. Energy Information Administration'.

dataset.description: Dataset identifier within the publishing organization, e.g. 'EIA-860 2023, Schedule 3'.

url.description: URL the data was retrieved from.

version.description: Data version or vintage, e.g. '2023 final'.

published_at.description: When the source published the data; null if unknown.

recorded_by.description: User or agent that recorded the value.

fields.description: Names of the component fields this provenance record applies to.
